title: cyclosorus × papilioides
intro: Cyclosorus × papilioides, commonly known as Chinese Leopards Bane, is a hybrid fern plant that is a cross between Cyclosorus serlus and Cyclosorus interruptus. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating fever. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus × papilioides are attributed to its ability to clear heat, reduce swelling, and promote recovery. Its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its effectiveness.
